title: The Break-Even Parallel Speedup: When Multithreading Saves Energy for Edge CPU Inference
description: Public artifact for an IEEE Computer Architecture Letters submission (CAL-2026-08-0285). 831 PMIC-measured runs on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76) establishing when multithreading saves energy on an edge CPU: energy improves exactly when the parallel speedup exceeds the package power ratio. The power ratio is a board constant (1.59 to 1.99x across configurations) while the speedup is a model property (0.95 to 2.63x), so the break-even condition is set by the workload rather than by the platform. Includes raw per-run power and latency records and a stdlib-only analysis pipeline that regenerates every published number from the released data.
